generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, citation is part of almost every piece of work you submit in the School of Sport. Each essay, lab report, coaching review and dissertation asks you to bring in evidence, reference it accurately, and keep to one style throughout. Done well, it protects your academic integrity and earns marks against the criteria. The same habit of sourcing a claim carefully carries into coaching, clinical and management practice, where trust depends on it.
